notes:
Cliopatria's single row -3000..-1701 is not split: the pages describe one archaeological civilisation in three phases (Early 3300-2600, Mature 2600-1900, Late 1900-1300 BCE), not successive states, so the phases are rename captions in one dossier of type culture (the group scope asks for the Indus 'as a culture'; the schema's culture type speaks of cultures before 3400 BCE, so the rendering agent should expect a muted, dotted culture that runs to -1300). The dossier extends the life to the infobox's 3300-1300 BCE with three new keyframes (-3300, -1900, -1700) and moves the Kot Diji (-2800) and Late Harappan (-1900) transitions to the pages' dates.

Unsettled: (1) no page opened gives the civilisation's area, so the infobox comparison could not be made; the 755,121 km2 full-extent shape matches the page's described reach except Shortugai and Daimabad, which are outliers; (2) the year the full extent was reached is Cliopatria's -2300 (confidence 1); (3) the -1800 shape's reach to 36.7N (Gilgit) and four edge cells in Sindh have no page, so the Late shape clips them (fix pass); (4) the -1760 shrink in southern Gujarat has no event and was undone; (5) the end year: 1300 is given by five pages, the 1400/1500 figures concern Harappa alone (settled in the fix pass); (6) the Mohenjo-daro and Harappa pages give the cities' coordinates (27.329N 68.139E; 30.629N 72.864E) but the schema has no capitals for a culture.

Gazetteer names used that it lacks: places Mehrgarh (29.39N 67.62E, Kachi plain, Balochistan); Harappa and Mohenjo-daro are present. Successor cultures needing dossiers from sa-01-x: Cemetery H, Ochre Coloured Pottery, Painted Grey Ware (none is a state).

Fix pass 2026-10-18 (reviewer's fail): (1) the second keyframe -2800..-2501 is now the -2700 shape plus Harappa 60 km and Mehrgarh 50 km; (2) -2500..-2301 adds Harappa, Mehrgarh (kept, because the Kachi plain continues at Nausharo, Harappan 3A), Mohenjo-daro and the three upper-Sindh cells Cliopatria drops, and is marked adjust; (3) the Mature shape (-2300..-1901) carries an eastern margin of Haryana, the Indian Punjab and Delhi 80 km from the full-extent gain at -2300, so the Late Harappan change at -1900 is a pure loss; the Late shape is clipped to the Mature shape and keeps Harappa 60 km. Checked offline with the gazetteer: every keyframe change equals the gains and losses of its year (gain -2800 38 cells, -2500 97, -2300 2,801; loss -1900 1,638, -1700 19). Disagreements with the reviewer: Mehrgarh stays in the culture to -2300 (Mehrgarh page: the town moved to Nausharo, five miles away); the Cemetery H range is already drawn by this dossier, so no separate cemetery-h-culture dossier is requested (the reviewer's point 6). Still thin: the year of the full extent (-2300, confidence 1; the sites-list, IVC and Periodisation pages are silent).
